calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current <> (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31')) AS flag_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_versions,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) AS all_members,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-08' AND valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-08' AND tier='Gold') AS gold_on_asof,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from<=DATE '2026-10-08' AND valid_to>=DATE '2026-10-08' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS overlap_asof,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from > DATE '2026-10-08') AS future_versions,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND is_current AND valid_from > current_date) AS gold_future,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM stg_member_updates) AS stg_members
